method.blinding: Opaque item identifiers; provider, run, Elo, and lineage are excluded from rater exports.
method.preference: Positive integer rank within a blinded comparison set.
method.uncertainty: Per-axis mean with a normal-approximation 95% confidence interval on the 1-5 scale.
method.agreement: Pairwise exact and within-one-point agreement across co-rated item-axis pairs, with Wilson 95% confidence intervals.

limitations: No independent domain-expert panel has been recruited or run.
No ratings, confidence intervals, agreement values, or quality conclusions are fabricated.
The implementation validates collection and analysis behavior only; it does not establish scientific-output parity with Google.
